title: Sage placements record
description: A placements record (PlacementsRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another placements record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

origin.description: Absolute metres that `Origin` and `Ground` placements are measured from. Unit: m. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

relativeTo.description: What a placement's `at` is measured from when it does not say. (PlacementFrame, default "World")

prefab.description: What to place. Names a prefab record. (RecordRef<PrefabRecord>)

at.description: Where, in the frame `relativeTo` names: absolute metres by default. Unit: m. (Vector3)

pitch.description: Degrees about the thing's X axis, applied before the yaw; positive tips its front up. Unit: deg. (float)

roll.description: Degrees about the thing's Z axis, applied first. Unit: deg. (float)

scale.description: Its size along its own X, Y and Z axes; 1 is the prefab's size. (Vector3)

name.description: Optional, so an outliner, ent_list and a wire can name it. (string)

id.description: A stable id for saves, unique in its list; left out, one is derived from its place in the list. (string)

relativeTo.description: What `at` is measured from; left out, the document's or scene's own `relativeTo`. (PlacementFrame?)

outputs.description: Entity I/O wires from this entity's outputs to other entities' inputs. (List<Connection>)

output.description: The output of this entity that sends it: OnStartTouch, OnUse, OnCameraOff; io_list lists them. (string)

target.description: Who receives it: an entity's name, or !self / !activator / !caller. (string)

input.description: The input it sends: Open, Kill, CameraOn; io_list lists them. (string)

parameter.description: Handed to the input: a hold time, a line to say, an output to fire. (string)

delay.description: Seconds between the output firing and the input arriving. Unit: s. At least 0. (float)

times.description: How many times it may fire; -1 = every time. (int)

requires.description: Fires only when this holds, asked of the activator (subject) and this entity (other); a wire that does not fire does not count toward times. (ICondition)

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
